title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
title_zh: ChartBmkAgent：基于稀疏错误分类规范的受控多智能体图表问答基准构建

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) continue to achieve substantial capability gains, while the conventional benchmark-development cycle has not kept pace with these advances, thereby delaying the systematic investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ( p = 8.96 × 10 − 6 p=8.96\times 10^{-6} ); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）持续取得显著的能力提升，但传统的基准开发周期未能与这些进步同步发展，从而延缓了对新发现的能力差距的系统性研究。 此类研究需要一种表达能力强的任务格式和按需构建流程：信息丰富的图表使图表问答（Chart QA）成为探究感知与推理耦合能力的合适工具。 自动化的图表问答构建旨在通过将已识别的能力差距转化为按需生成的针对性样本，缩短基准开发周期。 然而，现有方法通常将目标引导与从零生成相分离：目标引导系统往往需要预先准备的数据、图表或模板，而从零生成系统主要确保生成结果的合理性，却未明确控制新合成的需求与内容是否与外部指定的诊断目标保持一致。 我们提出了 ChartBmkAgent，它能够通过基于稀疏错误分类规范构建完整的图表问答样本，将已识别的能力差距转化为针对性的诊断证据。 在整个构建过程中，一个核心协调器负责管理专用智能体，要求每个阶段提供与原始错误类别对齐的证据，并记录每一项接受决策的依据。 在覆盖整个分类体系的 300 个样本中，MLLM 的准确率介于 32.7% 至 84.3% 之间，且不同类别的表现存在显著差异，表明生成的样本能够揭示能力差异。 在三组源模型对比中，针对特定目标的后续测试在匹配对照组上的得分分别为 50.0% 和 82.2%（p = 8.96 × 10⁻⁶）；所有六组跨模型对比均呈现出相同趋势，证明了目标验证与诊断数据生成的有效性。 多个评估模型检验了每个样本是否针对其指定的错误类别进行了测试；其中 86.4% 的样本满足该标准，为目标的保留提供了实证依据。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are revised rapidly and deployed across increasingly varied visual domains ( Fu et al. 2023 ; Liu et al. 2024a ; Li et al. 2024 ) . The failures that merit investigation may consequently change between model versions. Static benchmarks remain essential for reproducible comparison, but their coverage and difficulty are fixed at construction time. Model inspection, deployment feedback, or prospective stress testing may therefore expose a failure before an evaluator has a concrete sample that isolates it. At that point, the evaluation need exists only as a sparse description of the suspected error and its context. Turning each such description into a table, chart, question, answer, and validation procedure by hand is slow and expert-intensive, making a shorter path from observed failure to targeted evidence increasingly important.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正在迅速迭代，并被部署到日益多样化的视觉领域（Fu et al. 2023；Liu et al. 2024a；Li et al. 2024）。 因此，值得研究的故障在不同模型版本之间可能会发生变化。 静态基准测试对于可重复的比较仍然至关重要，但其覆盖范围和难度在构建时即已固定。 因此，模型检查、部署反馈或前瞻性压力测试可能能在评估者获得能够明确定位故障的具体样本之前，就暴露出该故障。 此时，评估需求仅表现为对疑似错误及其上下文环境的简要描述。 手动将此类描述转化为表格、图表、问题、答案和验证流程既耗时又依赖专家，这使得从观察到故障到获取针对性证据的更快捷路径变得愈发重要。

paragraphs.en: Chart question answering (Chart QA) provides a concrete setting in which to study this gap. Each sample couples visual encoding, textual recognition, numerical extraction, data semantics, and multi-step reasoning; similar wrong answers may therefore arise from different perceptual or inferential processes. Existing resources have progressed from controlled synthetic relations to realistic charts and demanding reasoning ( Kahou et al. 2018 ; Kafle et al. 2018 ; Methani et al. 2020 ; Masry et al. 2022 ; Xu et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2024 ; Masry et al. 2025 ) . The same expressiveness that makes Chart QA diagnostically useful also raises the burden of construction: a sample must be readable and correctly answered, instantiate the intended failure mechanism, and exclude shortcuts that bypass the evidence being tested.
paragraphs.zh: 图表问答（Chart QA）为研究这一差距提供了一个具体的场景。 每个样本都结合了视觉编码、文本识别、数值提取、数据语义和多步推理；因此，类似的错误答案可能源于不同的感知或推理过程。 现有资源已从受控的合成关系发展为逼真的图表和复杂的推理任务（Kahou et al. 2018；Kafle et al. 2018；Methani et al. 2020；Masry et al. 2022；Xu et al. 2024；Wang et al. 2024；Masry et al. 2025）。 使图表问答具有诊断价值的同一表达能力，也增加了构建的难度：一个样本必须易于阅读且能够被正确回答，体现预期的失败机制，并排除那些绕过所测试证据的捷径。

paragraphs.en: An error taxonomy can express the perceptual or reasoning construct to be tested while a few auxiliary conditions specify context and intended difficulty. It does not determine the sample semantics or the item-specific requirements needed to judge the resulting artifacts. Automating both introduces a risk of diagnostic drift : an early interpretation of the taxonomy can be built into the generated data, chart, question, and even their acceptance criteria. Downstream artifacts may then agree with one another while the final sample no longer measures the source error construct, and final artifact checks may miss a drift already embedded in the requirements they receive.
paragraphs.zh: 错误分类体系可以表达待测试的感知或推理结构，而一些辅助条件则用于明确上下文和预期难度。 它并不确定样本的语义，也不确定判断最终产物所需的具体项目要求。 将两者自动化会带来诊断偏移的风险：对分类体系的早期解读可能会被嵌入到生成的数据、图表、问题甚至其验收标准中。 此时，下游产物之间可能相互一致，但最终样本已不再衡量原始的错误结构，而最终产物的检查也可能遗漏早已嵌入其所接收要求中的偏移。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ChartBmkAgent, a multi-agent framework that separates generative agency from construction authority. Specialized agents propose requirements, artifacts, and evidence, while a central harness owns the typed construction state and alone authorizes transitions. It retains the source taxonomy and difficulty as root obligations, and a proposal can condition downstream generation only after a gate verifies both local correctness and inheritance of those obligations. Failed gates trigger bounded revision, backtracking, rejection, or termination. The same admission records form an item-level trace of the obligations, evidence, judgments, and control actions that governed construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ChartBmkAgent，这是一个将生成性智能体功能与构建权限分离的多智能体框架。 专用智能体负责提出需求、产出物和证据，而一个中央协调器则拥有类型化的构建状态，并独自授权状态转换。 它将源分类体系和难度作为根本义务予以保留，且一项提案只有在经过关卡验证其局部正确性并确认这些义务被继承后，才能触发下游生成。 关卡失败会触发有限范围的修订、回溯、拒绝或终止。 相同的准入记录构成了一项条目级的追溯记录，记录了在构建过程中所依据的义务、证据、判断和控制动作。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We formulate sparse diagnostic specification-to-sample construction for Chart QA: a complete probe is materialized from an error-category seed without sample-level scaffolds, providing a direct path from suspected failure to targeted evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为图表问答问题构建了稀疏诊断规范到样本的构造方法：一个完整的探针可从错误类别的种子中直接生成，无需样本级别的框架支持，从而为从疑似故障到目标证据的追溯提供了直接路径。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a harness-governed ChartBmkAgent that binds dynamically derived obligations to the root diagnostic construct and admits data, chart, and QA artifacts only when their inheritance evidence satisfies those obligations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种受约束管理的 ChartBmkAgent，它将动态推导出的义务与根诊断结构绑定，并且仅当数据、图表和质量保证工件的继承证据满足这些义务时，才允许其被接纳。

paragraphs.en: The harness retains the same admission evidence as an item-level construction trace, coupling online drift control with retrospective audit of error-category realization, difficulty realization, and acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 该约束机制保留了与项目级构建痕迹相同的准入证据，将在线漂移控制与对错误类别实现、难度实现和接受度的事后审计相结合。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate these claims through a 300-sample taxonomy-wide study over 17 MLLMs, paired targeted construction for three source models, a 40-seed paired direct-construction baseline, and a blinded 220-sample multi-model audit of exact error-description preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一项涵盖整个分类体系、涉及17个MLLM的300样本研究来评估这些主张，该研究包括针对三个源模型进行的配对目标构建、一个使用40个种子的配对直接构建基线，以及对精确错误描述保留情况进行的盲法220样本多模型审计。

paragraphs.en: Template-based chart benchmarks and hybrid construction fix much of the data semantics, question logic, or source material before an item is produced ( Kahou et al. 2018 ; Kafle et al. 2018 ; Methani et al. 2020 ; Masry et al. 2022 ) . These choices make construction tractable because the semantics or admissibility conditions are operationalized before generation. They also provide a reference point for regeneration and inspection, whereas an initially sparse diagnostic observation still requires item-level commitments to be derived during construction. paragraphs.en: Failure-targeted systems similarly connect observed weaknesses to new items through designated flaw families, retrieved seeds, reference assets, or fixed interaction structures ( Wu et al. 2024 ; Tang et al. 2026 ; Huang et al. 2026 ) . Their common challenge is not artifact generation alone, but retaining evaluation intent as the item is elaborated. Provided seeds or resources can delimit the candidate interpretation and support later comparison. When an error is observed before item-level sources or scaffolds exist, the same early interpretation can shape both generated artifacts and their checks; their agreement then need not show that the source failure was retained. ChartBmkAgent addresses this construction-time authority problem by retaining the source construct as an inherited obligation and admitting later requirements only with linked evidence. Table 1 summarizes the reported input and evidence properties.
paragraphs.zh: 以失败为目标的系统同样通过指定的缺陷族、检索的种子、参考资产或固定的交互结构，将观察到的弱点与新项关联起来（Wu et al. 2024；Tang et al. 2026；Huang et al. 2026）。 它们共同的挑战并非仅仅是生成产物，而是在对项进行详细阐述时保持评估意图。 提供的种子或资源可以限定候选解释的范围，并为后续比较提供支持。 当在项级来源或框架存在之前观察到错误时，同样的早期解释可能同时塑造生成的产物及其检验；此时，它们的一致性并不必然表明原始失败被保留下来。 ChartBmkAgent 通过在构建阶段保留原始结构作为继承义务，并仅在有相关证据支持时才接纳后续要求，来解决这一权威性问题。 表1总结了已报告的输入和证据特性。

paragraphs.en: Because it treats the error-taxonomy construct as an inherited root obligation, ChartBmkAgent can turn a concise seed into a complete, target-linked Chart QA sample without sample-level sources or scaffolds.
paragraphs.zh: 由于它将错误分类结构视为一种继承而来的根本性义务，ChartBmkAgent 能够将一个简洁的种子输入转化为一个完整的、与目标相关联的图表问答样本，而无需样本级别的来源或框架。

paragraphs.en: Chart QA combines data semantics, visual encoding, text recognition, numerical evidence, and inference; an observed error can consequently have several plausible causes. Existing collections broaden this coverage, while code-driven generators and templates support regeneration and local data-to-chart and answer checks ( Kahou et al. 2018 ; Kafle et al. 2018 ; Methani et al. 2020 ; Masry et al. 2022 ; Xu et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2024 ; Masry et al. 2025 ; Tang et al. 2025 ; Kondic et al. 2025 ; He et al. 2025 ; Xu et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2026 ; Kondic et al. 2026 ) . Such checks establish artifact consistency, but not necessarily that a newly introduced diagnostic target remains the mechanism required to answer the question. This distinction motivates target-linked construction evidence rather than replacing executable chart validation.
paragraphs.zh: 图表问答结合了数据语义、视觉编码、文本识别、数值证据和推理；因此，观察到的错误可能有多种合理的成因。 现有的数据集扩展了这一覆盖范围，而代码驱动的生成器和模板则支持再生成以及本地数据到图表的转换和答案验证（Kahou 等，2018；Kafle 等，2018；Methani 等，2020；Masry 等，2022；Xu 等，2024；Wang 等，2024；Masry 等，2025；Tang 等，2025；Kondic 等，2025；He 等，2025；Xu 等，2025；Liu 等，2026；Kondic 等，2026）。 这类验证可以确保人工制品的一致性，但未必能证明新引入的诊断目标仍然是回答该问题所需的机制。 这一区别促使我们采用与目标相关的构建证据，而非用其替代可执行的图表验证。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark-validity studies identify gaps between intended capabilities, task design, responses, and scores, including construct misalignment hidden by aggregate results ( Liu et al. 2024b ; Bean et al. 2025 ; Diddee et al. 2026 ; Jiang et al. 2026b ) . Datasheets, BenchmarkCards, and item-level releases make motivation, composition, risks, or frozen-item evidence inspectable ( Gebru et al. 2021 ; Sokol et al. 2025 ; Diddee et al. 2026 ; Jiang et al. 2026b ; Li 2026 ; Tang et al. 2026 ) . Such resources support retrospective scrutiny of a released collection, but their granularity may not reveal intermediate reinterpretations within a generative run. Correct scoring and inspection remain necessary; when a source construct is incrementally elaborated, they cannot by themselves establish which earlier interpretation guided the resulting item. ChartBmkAgent consequently records the inherited requirement, its evidence, and the corresponding decision while the item is constructed.
paragraphs.zh: 基准有效性研究揭示了预期能力、任务设计、响应和分数之间的差距，包括被汇总结果所掩盖的构念不一致问题（Liu et al. 2024b；Bean et al. 2025；Diddee et al. 2026；Jiang et al. 2026b）。 数据表、基准卡以及项目级发布内容使得其动机、构成、风险或固定项目的证据可以被审查（Gebru et al. 2021；Sokol et al. 2025；Diddee et al. 2026；Jiang et al. 2026b；Li 2026；Tang et al. 2026）。 这类资源支持对已发布集合的回顾性审查，但其颗粒度可能无法揭示生成过程中中间的重解释过程。 正确的评分和审查仍然是必要的；当源构念被逐步展开时，这些资源本身无法确定是哪一种早期的解释指导了最终形成的项目。 因此，ChartBmkAgent会在项目构建过程中记录继承下来的要求、相关证据以及相应的决策。

paragraphs.en: Iterative refinement, verification, constrained decoding, contracts, gates, and provenance constrain generated artifacts or record their decisions ( Madaan et al. 2023 ; Shinn et al. 2023 ; Dhuliawala et al. 2024 ; Geng et al. 2023 ; Geng et al. 2025 ; Simbola et al. 2026 ; Ivanov and Rana 2026 ; Jiang et al. 2026a ; Ranganath and Raghavendra 2026 ; Xiong et al. 2026 ) . Their governing structure is generally available before the constrained transformation. In sparse diagnostic construction, that structure must itself be elaborated: a short error label is not yet a complete contract, and progressive elaboration can otherwise introduce unrecorded assumptions. A contract may remain self-consistent with prior generated artifacts even when its operative assumptions no longer correspond to the diagnostic seed. The harness therefore admits a new requirement only when its lineage to the source construct is recorded, rather than treating consistency with prior generated artifacts as sufficient.

paragraphs.en: We conduct an experience-informed pre-specification of 60 chart-reading and reasoning error descriptions, drawing on recurring failures observed in practical MLLM use. paragraphs.en: Two study reviewers independently scored a pre-specified 60-sample set (one per description; 12 per batch) for answer correctness/recoverability and description–mechanism alignment. Ratings are unadjudicated and provide descriptive verification, not an external quality certification.
paragraphs.zh: 两名研究评审员独立地对一个预先指定的 60 个样本集合（每个描述对应一个样本；每批 12 个）进行评分，评估标准包括答案的正确性/可恢复性以及描述与机制的一致性。 两人分别对 49/60（81.7%）和 48/60（80.0%）的样本选择了“通过”；完全一致的情况为 52/60（86.7%）和 48/60（80.0%），存在 8 处和 12 处分歧。 这些评分未经最终裁定，仅用于提供描述性验证，而非外部质量认证。

paragraphs.en: Preliminary scan accuracy selects concrete descriptions for follow-up construction, not model-private capability signatures. For each cohort, two low-scoring descriptions seed 30 target samples and two higher-scoring descriptions from another same-level-1, level-2 family provide 30 controls. Pairs fix scene, chart type, difficulty, data setting, pipeline, and harness gates; only the description changes. We evaluate each cohort with all three models and analyze complete target–control pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 初步扫描的准确性用于为后续构建选择具体的描述，而非模型私有的能力特征。 对于每个队列，两个得分较低的描述会生成 30 个目标样本，而来自另一个同等级别 1、级别 2 家族的两个得分较高的描述则提供 30 个对照样本。 成对设置固定场景、图表类型、难度、数据设置、流程以及约束门限；仅描述部分发生变化。 我们使用全部三种模型评估每个队列，并分析完整的目标–对照配对。

paragraphs.en: For the three source-model comparisons, target accuracy is 23.3–36.7 points below control accuracy (Table 3 ; all paired exact McNemar p ≤ 0.0386 p\leq 0.0386 ). Across the six cross-model comparisons, the same direction holds with gaps of 10.0–30.0 points; three reach p < 0.05 p<0.05 , whereas three do not. Starting from an observed low-score description, ChartBmkAgent therefore constructs subsequent Chart QA samples that directionally validate and extend the observed difficulty against a strict matched control, without implying that the difficulty is unique to the source model.
paragraphs.zh: 在三组源模型比较中，目标准确率比对照准确率低 23.3–36.7 分（表 3；所有配对精确 McNemar 检验的 p 值均 ≤ 0.0386 p\leq 0.0386）。 在六组跨模型比较中，趋势保持一致，差距为 10.0–30.0 分；其中三组的 p 值 < 0.05 p<0.05，另外三组则未达到该显著性水平。 因此，ChartBmkAgent 从观察到的低分描述出发，构建后续图表问答样本，以验证并延伸所观察到的困难趋势，并与严格的匹配对照进行比较，但这并不意味着该困难仅存在于源模型中。

paragraphs.en: We audit 220 frozen samples (120 taxonomy-wide, 50 target, 50 control). GPT-5.6-Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, and Claude Opus 4.8 select the tested mechanism from four anonymized, paraphrased same-level-1 definitions in randomized order; outputs and assignments never feed back. The audit remains model-mediated because judges overlap with evaluated MLLMs, and a two-of-three majority defines preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们审计了 220 个冻结样本（120 个覆盖整个分类体系的样本、50 个目标样本和 50 个对照样本）。 GPT-5.6-Sol、Gemini 3.6 Flash 和 Claude Opus 4.8 会从四个经过匿名化和改写、处于同一级别 1 的定义中，以随机顺序选择所测试的机制；输出结果和分配情况绝不会反馈到模型中。 此次审计仍属于模型中介式审计，因为评审者与受评估的 MLLM 存在重叠，且“三人中两人同意”的多数原则决定了保留结果。

paragraphs.en: The full harness blocks every injected fault, while disabling either named gate lets all 40 pass that gate, a 100-point paired difference (95% paired-bootstrap CI: 100–100; exact McNemar p = 1.82 × 10 − 12 p=1.82\times 10^{-12} ; Table 5 ). When anchor-to-QA alignment is disabled, later checks reject 10%, final blind-majority judgment admits B B for 80% (95% CI: 67.5–92.5; p = 4.66 × 10 − 10 p=4.66\times 10^{-10} ), and the remaining 10% are semantically unresolved.

The direct GPT-5.5 arm receives the same scene, chart type, taxonomy description, and difficulty, then performs data, plotting-code/local-rendering, and image-grounded QA generation. It omits formal contracts, full-arm artifacts, critic feedback, gates or admission, semantic repair, backtracking, and candidate replacement; only absent provider responses receive infrastructure retries. Both arms use the same frozen post-hoc rubric.

paragraphs.en: The harness passes end-to-end on 31/40 seeds (77.5%), versus 21/40 (52.5%) for direct construction, a 25.0-point paired difference (95% CI: 5.0–45.0; exact McNemar p = 0.00635 p=0.00635 ; Table 6 ). paragraphs.en: ChartBmkAgent is designed to preserve a specified error-taxonomy label; it does not characterize every factor that affects a model’s success on a chart question. Scene and chart type are selected for compatibility and held fixed within matched target–control pairs, but we do not estimate their main effects or their interactions with the taxonomy, nor do the fixed 54 scenes and 57 chart types span the visual-design space. The benchmark is synthetic and chart-specific, and description-guided follow-ups are directed validation rather than an unbiased difficulty distribution. GPT-5.5 serves construction roles and is also evaluated, while every preservation judge belongs to the evaluated model set; these overlaps leave preservation evidence model-mediated rather than source-independent. The two-reviewer audit is small and not external. Finally, the drift ablation measures injected-fault containment, and the direct baseline isolates post-canonicalization control.
paragraphs.zh: ChartBmkAgent 的设计旨在保留指定的错误分类标签；它并未描述所有影响模型在图表问题中成功表现的因素。 场景和图表类型是出于兼容性考虑而选择的，并且在匹配的目标–控制对中被固定不变；但我们并未估计它们的主要效应或与分类标签的相互作用，而且固定的 54 个场景和 57 种图表类型也未覆盖整个视觉设计空间。 该基准是合成且针对特定图表的，而由描述引导的后续验证属于定向验证，而非无偏的难度分布。 GPT-5.5 承担了构建角色并同样被评估，同时每个保留判断者都属于被评估的模型集合；这些重叠使得保留证据更多是模型中介的结果，而非独立于源模型的存在。 两名评审员的审计规模较小，且并非外部审计。 最后，漂移消融测试衡量的是注入故障的抑制能力，而直接基线则隔离了后规范化控制的影响。

paragraphs.en: ChartBmkAgent addresses a practical gap in evaluation: a model failure may be recognizable before there is a chart, question, answer, template, or dataset that can test it. Starting only from a sparse error-taxonomy specification, the framework materializes a complete Chart QA probe while retaining the source construct and requested difficulty as construction roots. Specialized agents may propose semantics, data, rendering, anchors, and QA, but the harness alone admits downstream state after checking the evidence attached to each requirement. The resulting trace records not only what was admitted, but also the rejected candidates, revisions, and backtracks that led there. This makes construct preservation a construction-time condition rather than only a post hoc judgment of a completed item. Candidate content can be diverse, but only a state with evidence sufficient for the initial diagnostic obligation becomes construction authority. The trace consequently links the chart, QA, and admission decision back to the incomplete source observation instead of treating their mutual consistency as proof of diagnostic relevance.
paragraphs.zh: ChartBmkAgent 解决了评估中的一个实际空白：在出现可用于测试的图表、问题、答案、模板或数据集之前，模型失败可能就已经可以被识别出来。 该框架仅从稀疏的错误分类规范出发，即可生成一个完整的图表问答探针，同时保留原始构建结构以及所要求的难度作为构建根基。 专用智能体可以提出语义、数据、渲染、锚点和问答内容，但仅凭该工具本身，在验证每个要求所附的证据之后，才能允许下游状态的形成。 由此产生的追踪记录不仅保存了被接受的内容，还包括了导致最终结果的被拒绝候选项、修订版本和回溯步骤。 这使得结构保留成为构建阶段的一项条件，而不仅仅是事后对已完成成果的判断。 候选内容可以多种多样，但只有具备足够证据以满足初始诊断要求的状态，才能成为构建的权威依据。 因此，该追踪将图表、问答和接受决策与不完整的原始观察结果关联起来，而不是将其相互一致性视为诊断相关性的证明。

paragraphs.en: The empirical results support three bounded claims. First, the 300-item collection differentiates 17 MLLMs, whose accuracies span 32.7–84.3% and whose level-1 profiles differ. Second, descriptions selected from preliminary low scores seed follow-up samples that are consistently harder than strictly matched controls; this is directed validation of an observed difficulty, not a claim of model-private capability. Third, target preservation is supported by an 86.4% exact-description majority rate on 220 frozen samples, and the paired direct baseline shows a 77.5% end-to-end pass rate for the full harness versus 52.5% for three-call construction without it. The injected-fault ablation further identifies why an omitted anchor-to-QA check can leave semantically wrong samples admissible.
paragraphs.zh: 实证结果支持三项有限性主张。 首先，包含300个项目的数据集能够区分17种大型语言模型（MLLM），这些模型的准确率分布在32.7%至84.3%之间，且其一级特征也存在差异。 其次，从初步低分样本中选取的描述为后续样本提供了初始条件，而这些后续样本的难度始终高于严格匹配的对照组；这是对已观察到的难度的定向验证，而非主张模型具备私有能力。 第三，在220个冻结样本中，86.4%的精确描述多数率支持了目标保留的有效性；同时，配对直接基线模型在完整测试集上的端到端通过率达到了77.5%，而无需该机制的三次调用构建方式则仅为52.5%。 注入故障的消融分析进一步揭示了为何省略锚点到问答的检查步骤会导致语义错误的样本被接受。

paragraphs.en: These results do not establish source-independent semantic validity. We therefore define ChartBmkAgent as an auditable construction mechanism; independent external validation remains necessary. Extending the taxonomy, varying chart-design conditions, adding independent human review and judges, and testing other visual domains are necessary next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果并未确立与来源无关的语义有效性。 因此，我们将 ChartBmkAgent 定义为一个可审计的构建机制；但独立的外部验证仍然是必要的。 拓展分类体系、改变图表设计条件、加入独立的人工审查和评审员，以及测试其他视觉领域，是接下来必须采取的步骤。
